meaning: On the same alternating two-world ontology, Fact is every Bool-to-Prop truth set, holds is evaluation, and negation/conjunction closure is witnessed. Sound world-immanent makers cover every represented true proposition and satisfy maker necessitation; existence labels are coherent. The constant true proposition is necessary and has local makers, but no uniform maker and no necessary individual. This covers the whole specified propositional truth-set language, not every substantive metaphysical or aboutness thesis of unrestricted historical theories.
